purpose: Scenario articles (DC-17): one per intent goal; every step = checklist item → existing action article → its vendor sub-steps. Source for the generated registry.

articles.title: Launch your first funnel to validate an idea

steps.title: Create the first funnel
steps.summary: Open Onboardings and create a funnel from a template or from scratch; the canvas opens with a draft version.

steps.title: Connect your domain
steps.summary: Enter the domain, add the printed DNS records at your registrar, then verify — DNS is the slowest step, so start it first.

steps.title: Publish the funnel
steps.summary: Open the funnel on the canvas and press Deploy Web — the placement is created and published for you.

steps.title: Turn on first-party analytics
steps.summary: Enable the Segmently integration so Reports fill up; no vendor key is needed.

articles.title: Start selling: live Stripe, live products, paywall

steps.title: Create the first funnel
steps.summary: Open Onboardings and create a funnel; the canvas opens with a draft version.

steps.title: Connect your domain
steps.summary: Enter the domain, add the DNS records at your registrar, verify.

steps.title: Publish the funnel
steps.summary: Deploy Web from the canvas creates and publishes the placement.

steps.title: Turn on first-party analytics
steps.summary: Enable the Segmently integration so purchase reports fill up.

steps.title: Connect live Stripe
steps.summary: Activate the Stripe account first, then Connect Live Account; test-mode stays for sandbox checks.

steps.title: Create live products
steps.summary: On Paywall Products switch to the Live tab and create the products with their prices.

steps.title: Attach the products to the paywall screen
steps.summary: Open the paywall screen's Subscriptions section and pick the live products, then republish.

articles.title: Run ads: pixels, server-side events, attribution

steps.title: Create the first funnel
steps.summary: Open Onboardings and create a funnel.

steps.title: Connect your domain
steps.summary: Ad platforms trust a branded domain; add the DNS records and verify.

steps.title: Connect the Facebook pixel and Conversions API
steps.summary: Add the Facebook Pixel integration with the Pixel ID, then the Conversions API integration with the generated token.

steps.title: Connect the TikTok pixel and Events API
steps.summary: Add the TikTok Pixel integration with the pixel code, then the Events API integration with the access token.

steps.title: Turn on attribution on the placement
steps.summary: In the placement's Sources step switch on Facebook, TikTok and UTM attribution so click ids reach the pixels and Stripe.

articles.title: Add product analytics: GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude or PostHog

steps.title: Add your product analytics provider
steps.summary: Add the provider integration and paste the key from its project settings; this never blocks the launch.
